userStories.title: Add cache warmup validation with integrity check
acceptanceCriteria: Add a validate_entry() method to TranscriptCache that checks a cached entry has non-empty segments list, valid start_time/end_time on each segment, and non-empty text
Call validate_entry() during cache get() and discard invalid entries (log WARNING with video_id and reason)
Call validate_entry() during warmup_from_project() and skip invalid entries with a count summary log
Add test: cache entry with empty segments list is discarded on get()
Add test: cache entry with segments missing text field is discarded on get()
Add test: warmup_from_project skips invalid entries and logs count
userStories.notes: Tier: LOW (reliability). Files: src/transcription/cache.py (get() ~lines 168-240, warmup_from_project() ~lines 387-477). Currently cache entries are returned without validation. Corrupt or partial cache entries (e.g., from interrupted writes) can propagate empty or malformed segments downstream, causing subtle matching failures.

userStories.title: Add transcription batch retry budget tracking
acceptanceCriteria: Create a TranscriptionRetryBudget class (similar to CaptionRetryBudget) in src/transcription/retry_budget.py that tracks total attempts, failures, and cumulative backoff time across a batch
Add `retry_budget_max_attempts: int = 50` and `retry_budget_max_backoff_seconds: float = 180.0` to TranscriptionConfig
Integrate TranscriptionRetryBudget into transcribe_videos_parallel() to stop retrying when budget is exhausted, logging which videos were skipped
Add budget summary to TranscriptionMetrics (total_attempts, failed_attempts, budget_exhausted_count)
Add test: batch processing stops retrying individual videos when budget is exhausted
Add test: budget summary is included in returned metrics
userStories.notes: Tier: MEDIUM (reliability). Files: new src/transcription/retry_budget.py, src/transcription/parallel_processor.py (transcribe_videos_parallel ~lines 54-329), src/transcription/metrics.py, src/config/sections/core.py. Caption system has CaptionRetryBudget (src/caption/retry_budget.py) which prevents infinite retry loops. Transcription has no equivalent - a batch with many failing videos wastes time retrying endlessly within the hardcoded 2-retry limit per video, with no global budget.

userStories.title: Add delta index staleness detection with automatic rebuild
acceptanceCriteria: Add a check_staleness() method to DeltaIndex in src/transcription/delta_index.py that compares indexed video count against actual cache entries and returns (is_stale: bool, indexed_count: int, cache_count: int)
When staleness is detected (cache has >10% more entries than index), trigger automatic rebuild with a WARNING log
Add staleness check to the start of transcribe_videos_parallel() before processing begins
Add test: stale index (fewer entries than cache) triggers rebuild
Add test: fresh index (matching or close to cache count) does not trigger rebuild
userStories.notes: Tier: LOW (reliability). Files: src/transcription/delta_index.py, src/transcription/parallel_processor.py (~line 54-100). DeltaIndex tracks which videos have been transcribed for incremental processing. If the index file gets corrupted or out of sync with the actual cache (e.g., manual cache edits, interrupted writes), videos may be unnecessarily re-transcribed or skipped.

acceptanceCriteria: After transcribe_videos_parallel() completes, store TranscriptionMetrics summary dict in checkpoint.json under a 'transcription_metrics' key

Add test: transcription metrics are persisted in checkpoint after batch processing

userStories.notes: Tier: LOW (observability). Files: src/transcription/metrics.py (TranscriptionMetrics class), src/transcription/parallel_processor.py (return_metrics=True path ~lines 300-329), src/checkpoint.py. Currently TranscriptionMetrics are computed and optionally returned but never persisted. After a pipeline run, there's no record of transcription performance. Persisting to checkpoint enables cross-run comparison and debugging slow transcription batches.
